lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Desktop User
    participant UI as Management Repair Review
    participant Repair as Core Repair Orchestrator
    participant Committer as Canonical Event Committer
    participant Supervisor as Core Process Supervisor
    participant Gateway as Bootstrap Protocol Gateway
    participant Journal as Activation Journal
    participant Slots as Immutable Slot Manager
    participant Profile as Managed Local Profile Adapter
    participant Coordinator as Activation Rollback Coordinator
    participant Watchdog as Launch Watchdog
    participant Candidate as Candidate Core
    participant Previous as Previous Core
    participant Recovery as Core Recovery Coordinator
    participant Management as Management Chat

    Repair->>Gateway: QueryActivationCapability with provenance enrollment candidate and previous
    Gateway->>Profile: classify origin enrollment privileges volume selector and data compatibility
    Gateway->>Slots: verify managed root active candidate previous and helper separation
    Slots-->>Gateway: slot and enrollment observations
    Profile-->>Gateway: PlatformCapabilityReportV1
    alt EnrollmentRequired
        Gateway-->>Repair: enrollment required before approval or quiescence
        Repair->>Committer: commit capability evidence
        Committer-->>UI: activation disabled with Enable local repair activation
        opt User selects Enable local repair activation
            User->>UI: Request managed-local enrollment
            UI->>Repair: RequestManagedLocalEnrollment with projected provenance and artifact
            Repair->>Committer: commit explicit enrollment request
            Repair->>Gateway: PrepareManagedLocalEnrollment with bounded artifact and provenance
            Gateway->>Profile: build unprivileged EnrollmentPlanV1
            Gateway->>Slots: prepare helper-controlled root helper launcher journal selector and initial slot
            Slots-->>Gateway: EnrollmentPreparedV1 after durable verification
            Gateway-->>Repair: EnrollmentPreparedV1
            Repair->>Committer: commit prepared installation and launcher identity
            Committer-->>UI: restart explicitly through the stable launcher
        end
    else Unsupported
        Gateway-->>Repair: exact unavailable reason before quiescence
        Repair->>Committer: commit capability evidence
        Committer-->>UI: activation disabled with export rebuild or manual-update action
    else Supported ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1
        Gateway-->>Repair: Supported report and capability-generation digest
        Repair->>Committer: commit supported capability evidence
        Committer-->>UI: show local origin managed slots and same-user integrity
        User->>UI: Activate and restart expected candidate version
        UI->>Repair: ActivateAndRestart with capability digest
        Repair->>Committer: commit approval disclosure hash checkpoint rollback point and capability digest
        Committer-->>Repair: durable canonical acknowledgement
        Repair->>Gateway: authenticated RepairActivationBatonV1
        Gateway->>Profile: independently revalidate capability generation
        Gateway->>Slots: reverify candidate previous active and helper identities
        alt guarantee changed or revalidation Unsupported
            Profile-->>Gateway: UnsupportedV1 before quiescence
            Gateway->>Journal: store BootstrapResultV1 Unsupported
            Journal-->>Gateway: result durable
            Gateway-->>Repair: Unsupported and current core remains active
            Repair->>Committer: commit unsupported activation evidence
        else admission still Supported
            Profile-->>Gateway: ActivationPlanV1
            Slots-->>Gateway: candidate and previous VerifiedBuildSlotV1
            Gateway->>Journal: append baton report slots generations and independent deadlines
            Journal-->>Gateway: BatonAcceptedV1 durable
            Gateway-->>Repair: safe to quiesce
            Repair->>Supervisor: quiesce worker host and sidecar trees
            Supervisor-->>Repair: current ProcessGenerationV1 quiescence facts
            Repair->>Gateway: BootstrapCommandV1 BeginActivation
            Gateway->>Coordinator: start admitted activation
            Note over Repair,Gateway: Current core exits only after durable approval baton admission and child quiescence
            Coordinator->>Journal: append current-tree cleanup intent
            Coordinator->>Watchdog: await exit then clean complete current application tree
            Watchdog-->>Coordinator: ProcessTreeCleanupV1
            Coordinator->>Journal: append candidate selector intent
            Coordinator->>Profile: atomically apply and verify candidate selector
            Profile-->>Coordinator: SelectorMutationReceiptV1
            Coordinator->>Journal: append candidate launch intent with ProcessGenerationV1
            Coordinator->>Watchdog: launch candidate in verification-only mode
            Watchdog-->>Coordinator: LaunchObservationV1
            Candidate->>Gateway: CandidateGenerationReady with nonce identity hashes and plan
            Gateway->>Watchdog: authenticated generation handshake
            Watchdog->>Candidate: focused verification handoff bound to plan digest
            Candidate->>Gateway: FocusedVerificationCompleted with CapabilityOutcomeV1
            Gateway->>Watchdog: authenticated generation and outcome
            alt identity health and focused verification pass
                Watchdog-->>Coordinator: VerificationObservationV1 passed
                Coordinator->>Journal: store BootstrapResultV1 ActivatedVerified
                Journal-->>Coordinator: terminal result durable
                Candidate->>Gateway: ReadBootstrapResult for candidate generation
                Gateway->>Journal: read and verify receipt
                Journal-->>Candidate: BootstrapResultV1 ActivatedVerified
                Candidate->>Committer: commit activation and verification evidence
                Candidate->>Recovery: resume ManagementCheckpointRefV1 after committed receipt
                Recovery->>Management: resume the same Management Chat
            else crash timeout identity mismatch unhealthy or failed outcome
                Watchdog-->>Coordinator: WatchdogFailureV1
                Coordinator->>Journal: append rollback intent and failure proofs
                Coordinator->>Watchdog: terminate and prove empty candidate process tree
                Watchdog-->>Coordinator: ProcessTreeCleanupV1
                Coordinator->>Profile: restore and verify previous selector
                Profile-->>Coordinator: SelectorMutationReceiptV1
                Coordinator->>Slots: reverify previous whole-slot identity
                Slots-->>Coordinator: VerifiedBuildSlotV1
                Coordinator->>Watchdog: launch previous with fresh rollback ProcessGenerationV1
                Previous->>Gateway: CandidateGenerationReady with installation enrollment capability and rollback generation
                Gateway->>Watchdog: authenticate previous generation handshake
                alt previous generation healthy
                    Watchdog-->>Coordinator: previous generation healthy
                    Coordinator->>Journal: store BootstrapResultV1 RolledBack
                    Journal-->>Coordinator: terminal result durable
                    Previous->>Gateway: ReadBootstrapResult for rollback generation
                    Gateway->>Journal: read and verify receipt
                    Journal-->>Previous: BootstrapResultV1 RolledBack
                    Previous->>Committer: commit rollback and watchdog evidence
                    Previous->>Recovery: resume ManagementCheckpointRefV1 after committed receipt
                    Recovery->>Management: resume the same Management task with rollback reported
                else previous cannot launch safely
                    Watchdog-->>Coordinator: ManualRecoveryNoticeV1 with exact reason and observed slot state
                    Coordinator->>Journal: store BootstrapResultV1 ManualRecoveryRequired and notice
                    Journal-->>Coordinator: terminal result and native notice durable
                    Note over User,Watchdog: Next stable-launcher invocation shows only diagnostic ID recovery instructions and exit
                end
            end
        end
    end

data.title: Managed-local capability gate, explicit activation, watchdog verification, rollback, receipt, and Management resume
